newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rabobank sees further profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Rabobank sees further profit growth.

text.p: Dutch cooperative Rabobank Nederland BA said on Wednesday it expected further profit growth this year.
Partly because of some new activities, growth is expected both in the Netherlands and abroad.
"In line with this, the result will also show continuous growth in 1997, barring unforeseen circumstances," the bank said in a statement.
Rabobank's 1996 profit rose by 14 percent to 1.63 billion guilders ($867.6 million). Demand for banking services grew strongly and lending and provision income rose by double digits, it said.
